season.sn.title: Ramadan season
season.sn.head: Ramadan {year}
season.sn.sub: A new season opens on the first night of Ramadan.
season.sn.expected: Expected {date} · moon sighting may move it a day
season.sn.locked: Unlocks on the first night of Ramadan
season.sn.eidSub: The season is over. See what you did this Ramadan.
season.sn.liveSub: The season is open. Everything below is yours to use.
season.sn.castSub: Four friends come with Ramadan. Each brings a piece for your own character.
season.sn.castLive: Their pieces are in your wardrobe now.
season.sn.c.musaharatiLine: Walks the street before dawn with his drum, waking everyone for suhoor.
season.sn.c.nouraLine: Lights her lantern every night and carries it to taraweeh.
season.sn.c.hudaLine: Always has dates and water ready the moment the adhan of Maghrib is heard.
season.sn.c.yusufRole: Seeker of the Night of Qadr
season.sn.c.yusufLine: Stays up in the last ten nights, hands raised in du'a.
season.sn.khatmSub: All 30 juz on one ring. Every page you read in Ramadan lights its part.
season.sn.khatmEarly: Pick your plan now and the tracker is ready on the first night.
season.sn.khatmCompany: Keeping you company: the ring fills when you pick One or Two Khatms.
season.sn.khatmNone: Pick a plan to start the ring.
season.sn.planSet: Plan saved. It starts on the first night.
season.sn.skySub: A fanous garland and a crescent in your room’s window
season.sn.streakSub: Your flame under the crescent all month
season.sn.b.nightsGoal: Read on 5 of the last ten nights
season.sn.reminded: We’ll remind you the day before
season.sn.remindSet: Reminder set for the eve of Ramadan
season.sn.notifBody: The season is open: new characters, your Khatm tracker and seasonal badges.
season.sn.notifSoonBody: Pick your Khatm plan so it is ready on the first night.
season.sn.teaseSub: New characters, a Khatm tracker and seasonal rewards unlock on the first night of Ramadan.
season.sn.cardSub: New characters and a Khatm tracker are waiting
season.sn.cardLiveCompany: New characters are in your wardrobe
season.sn.tenSub: Each of the last ten nights brings its own quest. The odd nights are marked in gold: many seek the Night of Qadr in them.
season.sn.qadrGoal: Keep {n} nights for the Night of Qadr piece
season.sn.qadrHave: The Night of Qadr piece is yours
season.sn.chestSub: Your quest for tonight is done.
